prompt:
The file sections/rich-text-wrappers.liquid contains a finished Rich text section. Its markup can optionally wrap the content in a page-width container. It also uses a merchant-selectable wrapper element, heading blocks with a selectable heading tag, and a button block. The markup is correct and must stay byte-for-byte unchanged. The {% schema %} block is incomplete and does not provide several settings the markup reads. Replace the JSON inside the single top-level {% schema %}...{% endschema %} block so it is exactly the following, keeping keys and array entries in the order given. Top-level keys, in order: - name: "Rich text" - tag: "section" - class: "section-rich-text" - settings, blocks, max_blocks, presets (described below) settings (in this order): 1. checkbox, id "use_container", label "Constrain to page width", default true. 2. select, id "wrapper_tag", label "Content wrapper element", options in order: div/"Div", article/"Article", aside/"Aside" (value/label), default "div". 3. select, id "text_alignment", label "Text alignment", options: left/"Left", center/"Center", right/"Right", default "center". 4. range, id "padding_top", label "Top padding", min 0, max 100, step 4, unit "px", default 36. 5. range, id "padding_bottom", label "Bottom padding", min 0, max 100, step 4, unit "px", default 36. Within each setting, use the key order type, id, label, then options/min/max/step/unit as applicable, then default. blocks (in this order; keys in the order type, name, limit if any, settings): 1. type "heading", name "Heading", limit 2. Settings: - inline_richtext "heading", label "Heading", default "Talk about your brand" - select "heading_size", label "Heading size", options h1/"Large", h2/"Medium", h3/"Small", default "h2" 2. type "text", name "Text", no limit. Settings: - richtext "text", label "Text", default "

Share information about your brand with your customers.

" 3. type "button", name "Button", limit 1. Settings: - text "button_label", label "Button label", default "Learn more" - url "button_link", label "Button link", with no default max_blocks: 6. presets: exactly one preset, name "Rich text". Its blocks, in order, are heading, text and button. Each preset block has only a type key. Do not add any other keys, such as info or enabled_on. Change only sections/rich-text-wrappers.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
